evidence: Adds the `-ipcconnect` option to `bitcoin-gui` in multiprocess builds and connects the GUI to a running `bitcoin-node` over IPC.
rationale: Enables `bitcoin-gui` to connect to a running background node instead of tightly coupling node lifecycle to the GUI process. As stated in the PR description, this 'allows the GUI to be started and stopped independently of the node', a key milestone for multiprocess process separation (#28722).
